    • selection

      public List<Joueur> selection(String category)
      Selects the SELECTION_SIZE Joueurs in best condition (weight) that play in a specific category place.
      Parameters:
      category - Place where Joueurs should play in.
      Returns:
      A immutable list of the selection's result.
      See Also:
      • @implNote: Can a Java 8 `Stream` be parallel without you even asking for it? - Stack Overflow
      Implementation note:
      We used Stream.reduce(Object, java.util.function.BiFunction, java.util.function.BinaryOperator) but we didn't implemented the combinator as it will never be called because we never wanted to make this stream parralel (We also used BaseStream.sequential() to force the behaviour, but its useless). If we need it, don't forget to implement it.
